column1: # Breaks of the flow harness (flows/rules.ts and flows/run.sh). Run with:
# tests/mutate.sh --jobs 4 --cmd 'NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" npx cucumber-js --tags "@flow-deliver or @flow-discover"' tests/mutations/flows.tsv
# The substitutions use ~ as the delimiter, because the TypeScript regexes hold many slashes. Three breaks are equivalent: no input tells them from the real code.
